card.name: Mid-sentence words in label instructions
card.fires_on: Ordinary connecting words or nouns inside instruction sentences, such as 'visits' after 'follow-up', 'until' after 'barrier method', or 'than' after 'more'. It also fires in the patent line 'but would nevertheless be a routine undertaking'.

modes.label: Instruction continuations
modes.description: Word that continues a patient instruction about follow-up, barrier methods or symptom duration.
modes.example: Keep all follow-up<< visits>> with your healthcare provider as scheduled.

modes.label: Barrier method until
modes.description: The word 'until' after advice to use a barrier method.
modes.example: , the woman should be advised to use a barrier method<< until>> 7 days after insertion.

modes.label: Patent boilerplate phrase
modes.description: Words in 'would nevertheless be a routine undertaking'.
modes.example: time-consuming, but<< would>> nevertheless be a routine undertaking for those having

card.writes: It lowers words about experts and expertise, which does not point to a clear output effect on drug text.
card.plain: It responds to everyday linking words in label instructions, such as follow-up visits or using a barrier method until a set time.
